forbidden_semantic_sources: any Unit003-008 authored scientific directory or artifact
any external source-code, documentation, issue, test, or discussion specific to a held-out target before that unit's machine-first E0 output is sealed
development_firewall.external_research_policy: Methodological research is allowed. Target-specific semantic inspection of a held-out unit is forbidden before that unit's machine-first output seal.
development_firewall.guard_only_rule: Guard-only files may be read solely to verify enrollment identity, ordering, and pristine authoring/verdict flags. Their target-specific semantic content may not be used to design E0.

architecture.trusted_authority: E0 never replaces the frozen scientific producer/consumer or issues a canonical Corpus verdict.

gold_isolation.gold_authority: Existing prospective Corpus authoring and scientific execution protocol
gold_isolation.contamination_policy: If E0 output is revealed to gold authors before gold freeze, the unit may still be scientifically valid but may not be claimed as a held-out E0 model-acquisition evaluation.

prequential_rule: TEST_THEN_LEARN: freeze engine Ei, seal machine-first output on next held-out unit, independently freeze human gold, score Ei, only then may that unit enter development data for Ei+1.

evaluation_metrics.one_unit_policy: Unit003 metrics are descriptive plus hard-stop checks; no population-level accuracy claim is permitted from one held-out unit.

hard_stops: false stable: E0 predicts consequence stability where the canonical scientific result establishes a consequence regression
unsupported established fact: an E0 semantic node/edge or refinement relation marked ESTABLISHED lacks evidence or is contradicted by frozen human gold
silent unknown: missing material semantics are treated as established compatibility instead of UNRESOLVED/ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE
held-out contamination before E0 output seal
gold contamination by E0 output before gold freeze
post-result change to evaluation metrics, hard-stop definitions, or baseline semantics without an explicit timed amendment
E0 output represented as a canonical scientific verdict

baseline_contract.B0_SURFACE: Reports callable/schema/argument surface only and is prohibited from claiming consequence preservation.
baseline_contract.B1_NAME_SHAPE: Finds candidate semantic coordinates from names/shapes without operative flow semantics.
baseline_contract.B2_FLOW_ONLY: Tracks candidate coordinate flow to effect/request sinks while ignoring source consequence and failure interpretation.
baseline_contract.ORACLE_HUMAN_GOLD: Post-freeze evaluation reference only; never available to machine-first E0 execution.
baseline_contract.extension_rule: Carrier-specific external baselines may be added only by a pre-result amendment for the held-out unit on which they will be scored.

cegar_policy.initial_model: minimal conservative CIR with explicit unknowns
cegar_policy.refinement_trigger: a candidate witness or required VBE obligation cannot be classified at current evidence strength
cegar_policy.allowed_refinement: request or acquire the minimum additional evidence needed to resolve the specific uncertainty
cegar_policy.forbidden_refinement: change the frozen source consequence, evaluation metric, or verdict semantics to eliminate an inconvenient counterexample
cegar_policy.spurious_counterexample_rule: A counterexample may be classified spurious only by new evidence or an identified modeling error recorded in the refinement trace.

objective_order: minimize number of differing world coordinates
minimize supporting context/evidence not required for the failure predicate

amendment_rule: Any change after this freeze requires a numbered amendment stating timing relative to held-out inspection/output/gold/result and whether the change could affect E0 scoring.
